title: Energy × compute
question: Can coordinated energy and compute planning improve useful work within a fixed review budget?

sources.title: Original α-AGI Insight experience
sources.text: The original interactive interface presents a $15 quadrillion illustrative scenario envelope, sector opportunities, proof debt and a claim boundary. It is a concept reference; it does not establish a realized economic valuation.

sources.title: Energy × compute: synthetic planning fixture
sources.text: This scenario contains authored hypotheses and deterministic task fixtures. Task validity is known benchmark ground truth. Durations, deadlines, prices and reviewer failure domains are assumptions, not measured operational performance. Training and holdout IDs are disjoint, but both fixture sets are public.

claims.title: Recover stranded energy
claims.hypothesis: Flexible computing could use otherwise curtailed energy without increasing peak demand.
claims.target: Reduce curtailment against a matched baseline without increasing peak draw.
claims.evidence_needed: Meter generation, demand and workload completion across matched periods; publish the counterfactual and grid constraints.

claims.title: Schedule useful compute
claims.hypothesis: Deadline-aware placement could improve completed compute work per planning credit.
claims.target: Improve on-time valid output at the same budget without accepting invalid tasks.
claims.evidence_needed: Compare an untouched workload against the baseline; include full scheduling traces, energy and reviewer time.

claims.title: Extend battery life
claims.hypothesis: Maintenance informed by measured degradation could reduce storage replacement cost.
claims.target: Demonstrate a longer measured cycle life under matched temperature and load.
claims.evidence_needed: Run matched cell tests with raw telemetry, intervention logs and independent replication.

claims.title: Account for marginal emissions
claims.hypothesis: Load shifting could reduce marginal emissions while meeting service deadlines.
claims.metric: Measured kg CO2e per completed task
claims.target: Lower marginal emissions with equivalent service quality.
claims.evidence_needed: Use timestamped grid and load measurements; disclose emissions factors and uncertainty.

claims.title: Clear the interconnection queue
claims.hypothesis: A shared evidence dossier could reduce avoidable review cycles.
claims.metric: Days and review hours to a complete application
claims.target: Reduce missing-evidence rework without weakening requirements.
claims.evidence_needed: Measure review outcomes before and after deployment, controlling for project complexity.

claims.title: Separate the validators
claims.hypothesis: Reviewers with distinct failure domains could resist a single compromised group.
claims.target: Accept zero injected invalid cases in a specified test set.
claims.evidence_needed: Document reviewer independence, inject faults and publish every acceptance and rejection.

title: Science × discovery
question: Which research workflow produces more reviewable results without hiding validation work?

sources.title: Original α-AGI Insight experience
sources.text: The original interactive interface presents a $15 quadrillion illustrative scenario envelope, sector opportunities, proof debt and a claim boundary. It is a concept reference; it does not establish a realized economic valuation.

sources.title: Science × discovery: synthetic planning fixture
sources.text: This scenario contains authored hypotheses and deterministic task fixtures. Task validity is known benchmark ground truth. Durations, deadlines, prices and reviewer failure domains are assumptions, not measured operational performance. Training and holdout IDs are disjoint, but both fixture sets are public.

claims.title: Make experiments replayable
claims.hypothesis: Structured experiment records could reduce time to reproduce a reported result.
claims.target: Improve replication time without reducing coverage of negative outcomes.
claims.evidence_needed: Provide raw data, a preregistered method, environment lock and blinded replication.

claims.title: Triage evidence safely
claims.hypothesis: Evidence-linked review could help specialists find unsupported health claims sooner.
claims.target: Reduce misses on a blinded, specialist-reviewed set.
claims.evidence_needed: Use a licensed, de-identified test set and independent clinical review; measure harms and false positives.

claims.title: Prioritize candidate materials
claims.hypothesis: Budgeted experiments could identify more qualifying materials per laboratory hour.
claims.target: Improve replicated yield over a prespecified baseline.
claims.evidence_needed: Run controlled experiments with calibration, failed candidates, raw results and independent reproduction.

claims.title: Budget the reasoning loop
claims.hypothesis: Explicit compute and review budgets could improve research throughput.
claims.target: Meet or exceed baseline output under the same resource limits.
claims.evidence_needed: Hold out workload cases before tuning; record compute, reviewer effort and failure cases.

claims.title: Transfer usable knowledge
claims.hypothesis: Evidence-backed learning material could improve demonstrated task performance.
claims.target: Improve post-training task performance against a randomized control.
claims.evidence_needed: Preregister outcomes; use consented participants, randomized groups and blinded grading.

claims.title: Preserve negative results
claims.hypothesis: A reviewable Chronicle could prevent failed results from silently re-entering production.
claims.target: Zero unreviewed reintroductions in a defined replay exercise.
claims.evidence_needed: Test revocation, restoration, replay and conflicts; include tampered history and stale evidence.

title: Enterprise × machine labor
question: Can a redesigned agent firm clear a service queue while retaining independent checks and human control?

sources.title: Original α-AGI Insight experience
sources.text: The original interactive interface presents a $15 quadrillion illustrative scenario envelope, sector opportunities, proof debt and a claim boundary. It is a concept reference; it does not establish a realized economic valuation.

sources.title: Enterprise × machine labor: synthetic planning fixture
sources.text: This scenario contains authored hypotheses and deterministic task fixtures. Task validity is known benchmark ground truth. Durations, deadlines, prices and reviewer failure domains are assumptions, not measured operational performance. Training and holdout IDs are disjoint, but both fixture sets are public.

claims.title: Deliver reviewable work
claims.hypothesis: Separating execution and review could increase useful service throughput.
claims.target: Improve output at the same credit budget with zero injected-invalid acceptances.
claims.evidence_needed: Use representative service tasks, held-out ground truth and auditable reviewer assignments.

claims.title: Plan safe handoffs
claims.hypothesis: Explicit human review capacity could reduce unsafe automation handoffs.
claims.target: Release zero actions lacking required review.
claims.evidence_needed: Exercise failure scenarios with independent safety review before any physical deployment.

claims.title: Account for full cost
claims.hypothesis: Including verification overhead could improve the accuracy of project costing.
claims.target: Keep cost error within a preregistered tolerance.
claims.evidence_needed: Measure labor, compute, review, insurance and settlement costs; report uncertainty and losses.

claims.title: Reduce queue bottlenecks
claims.hypothesis: Capacity-aware routing could lower deadline misses during workload bursts.
claims.target: Reduce misses without increasing the budget or weakening the quorum.
claims.evidence_needed: Replay burst workloads and an untouched holdout; preserve all task-level timings.

claims.title: Make operators effective
claims.hypothesis: Guided explanations could reduce operator errors during recovery.
claims.target: Improve successful recovery on an unfamiliar scenario.
claims.evidence_needed: Run usability sessions with task completion, error counts, accessibility checks and participant feedback.

claims.title: Gate capability promotion
claims.hypothesis: Replay plus explicit operator review could stop stale results entering the Chronicle.
claims.target: Reject every stale and tampered bundle in a declared test set.
claims.evidence_needed: Change inputs, results and history; verify rejection and document the limits of local hashes.
